rule: A PLATFORM file is one the platform itself writes, not a shelter: it must never sit under a shelter's own Drive root (shelters.drive_root_folder_id). Every platform path is declared here with a reason, and scripts/check-platform-files.mjs (in npm run lint) fails when a script that writes to Google Drive is in neither list below. Adding a platform file means adding an entry here, which is the decision; the check only makes it impossible to skip. NOT a complete inventory of the Drive tree: files put there by hand cannot be found from the repository and are a separate question for Lutan (#shfil).

platformFolder.account: the platform's own Google account (the Cooper Jaidee one), signed in with the BACKUP_GOOGLE_OAUTH_* identity from #civwx
platformFolder.piDestination: <mirror dest>/_platform, a sibling of the per-shelter folders and never inside one; see scripts/pi/drive-mirror.mjs

platformPaths.reason: The icon library is drawn by the platform from the route registry and is the same for every shelter. Lutan ruled 2026-11-20 it moves to the platform folder (#shfil).

Database dumps belong to the platform, on their own account and folder since #civwx (2026-11-19). Declared here so it is on the list; not re-pointed by #shfil. Known residue: backup.mjs still falls back to Backups/ under GOOGLE_DRIVE_ROOT_FOLDER_ID when BACKUP_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID is unset.

otherDriveWriters.reason: Read-only: a token refresh and one Drive about GET to tell whether two tokens are the same account; writes nothing.
Read-only probe of one token and its root folder; writes nothing.
Operator copy of a whole shelter tree into another shelter root (UAT/dev); shelter data, not platform files.
Operator move of a shelter's whole tree into the shelter's own Google account (dev/UAT; production is a deliberate later run); shelter data, not platform files. Reads the old account only.
Operator split of one shelter tree between prod and test roots; shelter data. The icon prefix is classified leave (a platform file) since #shfil.
Reads and changes sharing on a shelter's own files.
Diagnostic that writes and trashes a probe file in the shelter root it is pointed at.
Connects a shelter's own Drive; the files are that shelter's.
Pull-only: every Drive call is a GET.
Trashes dev shelter files when dev data is reset; shelter data.
Files lab reports in the served shelter's own Blood Work folders.
